economic_hypothesis: A bounded forty-session price inventory with declining recent turnover represents quiet ownership. A non-limit 1%-8% opening gap followed by at least 1.5x turnover, a close in the upper 30% of the session, and a completed close above the known forty-session inventory ceiling indicates new information being accepted at higher prices without relying on an untradeable limit close.

stage_a.strict_true_gap_rejected_outcome_blind: The strict no-trade interval had insufficient annual coverage; the final contract uses an executable opening gap and was frozen before returns.

frozen_signal.history: sixty completed same-symbol sessions all hard-valid, tradable, market-rule-valid and corporate-action-valid
frozen_signal.platform: maximum coordinate high and minimum coordinate low over forty completed sessions before signal
frozen_signal.turnover_contraction: mean turnover of prior 20 completed sessions <= mean turnover of sessions 60 through 21 before signal
frozen_signal.breakout: signal completed coordinate close > prior forty-session coordinate high

execution.entry: first legal executable daily open after completed signal, no later than three market sessions

order: highest median annual mean net return
